The Gettysburg Address was delivered by President **Abraham Lincoln**.  
He died **15 April 1865 at 7:22 a.m.** while in the Petersen House on H Street in Washington, D.C. (about nine hours after being shot at Ford’s Theatre).  

*Source:* “Assassination of Abraham Lincoln – Wikipedia” (see the “Death of Lincoln” section, which lists the date and time of his death).
